obligations.expected_behavior: When a fresh-checkout evaluation encounters a reproducibility mismatch, the evaluated route fails closed.
forbidden_result: The route proceeds despite the fresh mismatch.
The mismatch is treated as a successful or otherwise open result.
obligations.observable_result: The fresh-checkout fixture produces a fail-closed outcome on the fresh mismatch.
obligations.state_after: Evaluation is fail closed and no mismatched result is accepted.
obligations.state_before: A fresh checkout has a reproducibility mismatch during evaluation.
obligations.subject: NFR-3 reproducibility evaluation
obligations.trigger: A reproducibility mismatch occurs in a fresh checkout.

obligations.expected_behavior: Verify the reproducibility behavior with an isolated fresh-checkout fixture while holding all other inputs constant.
forbidden_result: The verification uses a non-isolated fixture.
Other inputs vary during the verification, preventing attribution of the result to the fresh mismatch.
obligations.observable_result: An isolated fresh-checkout fixture is used and all non-trigger inputs remain constant throughout the verification.
obligations.state_after: The fail-closed result is verified under controlled, reproducible fixture conditions.
obligations.state_before: The reproducibility behavior requires an independent controlled verification.
obligations.subject: NFR-3 reproducibility verification
obligations.trigger: Verification of the fresh-mismatch behavior is performed.
